title: fix(spec,metadata-protocol): a dashboard's packaged translation catalog yields to a published org overlay (#20680)
body:
Part of #20680. This PR lands the two producer halves: the translator rule in `@objectstack/spec` and the packaged-base accessor in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`. Two halves stay open, so the card must stay open after this merges. The first is the `packages/rest` read-path face, which hands the dashboard's packaged base to the translation; triage names it a per-layer child, and the seat files it, dashboards only, blocked by this PR (seat answer 5900364303 on #20680). The second is the console renderer, which is not measured here (see the acceptance notes).

Clause-②: yes

## The identity, measured first (as the dispatch ordered)

**Harness.** `@objectstack/verify`'s `bootStack(showcaseStack, { orgContext: true })`, which boots the real showcase composition in process: HTTP through the real Hono app, SQLite, an org-bound admin, and a member of the same org who signed up. The tree is `origin/main` at `5757463712`. I spied on `sys_metadata` `findOne` during direct `protocol.getMetaItem` calls to see which branch answered. The probe was a scratch file and is not committed.

| step | identity used | branch that answered | widget title served |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PUT …/system_overview?mode=draft` | row `type: dashboard`, `name: system_overview`, `package_id: null`, `organization_id: ORG`, `state: draft` | write | stored "Total Users (edited-20680)" |
| `POST …/publish` | the same row, `state: active` | write | stored the edit |
| `protocol.getMetaItem({ organizationId: ORG })` | lookup `type: dashboard, name, state: active, organization_id: ORG` (no package filter) | step 1, the `sys_metadata` overlay lookup, which hit that row | **edited** |
| `protocol.getMetaItems({ organizationId: ORG })` | union read | overlay row | **edited** |
| `GET …?layers=true` (admin and member) | the same row | layered read | overlay and effective **edited**, `overlayScope: org` |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/system_overview` (admin and member) | the same protocol read, then the REST translation | overlay, then `translateDashboard` | "Total Users" (en), "用户总数" (zh-CN) |
| `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard` (admin and member; this list is what the console builds the board from) | the same | the same | "Total Users" / "用户总数" |
| control `showcase_ops_dashboard`, same boot | identical row shape (`package_id: null`, same org) | the same | **edited**, both doors |

The served `_packageId: com.objectstack.plugin-auth` is the code artifact's protection envelope. `mergeArtifactProtection` grafts it onto the overlay body, and plugin-auth's manifest registers `SystemOverviewDashboard`. It is not a second identity that the overlay missed.

**Hypotheses.** H1 (the write and the plain read disagree on `package_id`): falsified. H2 (an earlier branch answers before the overlay lookup): falsified, because step 1 answered. H3 (the list read carries its own mismatch): falsified at the protocol; the REST list shows the same translation effect as the item read. H4 (the control works because it is keyed differently): falsified, because both are keyed identically. The difference is that `platform-objects` ships an `en` bundle whose `dashboards.system_overview.widgets.WIDGET_ID.title` repeats each shipped title, while the showcase bundle carries no widget titles for its dashboard. H5 (`packages/rest` is not the cause): partly held. REST is not where the wrong value is produced, but its read path is where the base has to be threaded in, so that half is the per-layer child.

**The producer.** `translateDashboard` (`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) applied the catalog over whatever the document said. ADR-0029 D9.2a records one rule for both object layers, *an explicit override beats a packaged default*, and #8284 implemented it for objects' three scalars only. This PR applies the same comparison to dashboards.

## What changes

- `translateDashboard` takes `TranslateDocumentOptions` (previously `ResolveOptions`; the new type adds only the optional `packagedBase`). When a base is supplied, the catalog replaces a string only while that string still equals its packaged counterpart. The rule covers the dashboard `label` and `description`, each widget's `title`, `description` and sub-caption (`options.description`), each global filter's label, and each static option label. Each string is matched by the key the bundle uses for it: widget id, filter key, or option value. A part that the base does not carry counts as authored, following the object rule "a base that declares no such scalar". With no base, the output is byte-identical to before.
- The comparison is still one implementation. `scalarOverridesPackagedBase` now delegates to a private `valueOverridesPackagedBase` that takes any key. Its exported signature is unchanged, and its body is the same three lines.
- `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getPackagedDashboardBase(name)` is the dashboard twin of `getPackagedObjectBase`. It is `lookupArtifactItem('dashboard', name)` and nothing wider, so an overlay hydrated under the plain registry key can never come back as the base. It answers `undefined` for a dashboard no code package ships, for an unknown or empty name, and for a registry that cannot answer.

## Readers of the changed functions, and which served answers move

- `translateDashboard` is reached only through `translateMetadataDocument('dashboard', …)` in `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, by both `translateMetaDocument` (item) and `translateMetaList` (list). Both pass `packagedBase: packagedObjectBaseOf(…)`, which is `undefined` for every type but `object`. So no serving path supplies a dashboard base today, and the new branch never runs in production until the REST child lands. objectui imports none of these functions; it mentions them in comments only.
- `scalarOverridesPackagedBase` is read by `translateObject` (spec) and by the `SchemaRegistry` fold (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`, the ADR-0029 D9.2a precedence). Its semantics are unchanged. The objectql suite, 6682 tests, is green against the rebuilt spec `dist`.
- `getPackagedDashboardBase` has no caller yet. The REST child is its first reader.

**Before/after, measured in the real boot.** I ran the same probe on two builds. The before build was `5757463712`, in a throwaway worktree. The after build was this branch, with `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` rebuilt. Each run covered admin and member, en and zh-CN, and three phases: pristine; after publishing overlays on `system_overview` and `showcase_ops_dashboard`; and after resetting both. Each run read the dashboard list and each item (all 4 dashboards), the view list (35 views), the app list, and 4 object items (`showcase_project`, `showcase_account`, `showcase_task`, `sys_user`). I compared label, title, filter and option strings plus a normalized hash of every body. **Differences: 0.** No other dashboard, view, app or object changes its answer with this PR alone.

**Positive controls in the same runs.** Unedited translated items keep their translations in zh-CN: `system_overview` "系统概览" / "用户总数"; the showcase global filters "任务状态" and "区域", with their option labels; views "进行中" and "紧急"; the app "功能展示"; objects "项目", "任务" and "用户". `showcase_account` keeps serving its extension label "Account (Success Overlay)", which is the #8284 object path, unchanged.

**The whole chain with the REST face applied** (a throwaway worktree, **not** this branch): a nine-line change to `meta-item-read-gate.ts` passes `getPackagedDashboardBase(name)` for `dashboard`. With it, the same probe differs from this branch in exactly 16 fields, all of them `system_overview`'s edited widget, for admin and member, en and zh-CN, item and list (title, plus the body hashes). The edit is served in both locales, the unedited sibling widget stays translated ("活跃会话"), reset restores "Total Users" / "用户总数", and the showcase control is unchanged. That is the card's pin set, measured one layer up from this PR.

## Published surface (for the Clause-② line)

- `@objectstack/spec`: no export is added, removed or renamed (`check:api-surface`: "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged"). One exported function's parameter type widens: `translateDashboard`'s `opts` goes from `ResolveOptions` to `TranslateDocumentOptions`. Every existing call still compiles. `translateMetadataDocument` already declared and passed `packagedBase`.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: one new public method on the exported `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, `getPackagedDashboardBase`.
- Measured against the question "does this widen an accept set or the public surface", both facts read as a widening. The seat answered (5900364303 on #20680): `Clause-②: yes`, and both changesets are `minor`. The claim's original `no` is corrected there.

## No documented rule is reversed

- `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` says: "The authored label is the default locale's text … Shipping a `zh-CN` bundle … still works and still wins." That describes a package author's own label against the package's own bundle. That case is kept: a value equal to the packaged declaration still gets the catalog, and so does a label written as an inline locale map, because only a string counts as an override.
- ADR-0029 D9.2a and the #8284 ruling (2026-08-13) say that an explicit override beats a packaged default, in the source locale as well. This PR applies that ruling to dashboards; it does not reverse it. No ADR states that a catalog wins over a tenant's overlay.

## Tests

HEAD `d89ebb8c1c` for everything below.

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`, a new block of 9 tests. It covers an untouched document (catalog applied to every string), an edited title in en and zh-CN, per-string judgement, every string kind, a tenant-added widget, no base as the pre-change control, the ruled no-op edge, no mutation of inputs, and the generic dispatcher. The whole spec `local` project passed: 575 files, 16969 tests.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-packaged-dashboard-base.test.ts`, 8 tests against a real `SchemaRegistry`. It covers the packaged body, immunity to an overlay hydrated under the plain key, the three `undefined` answers, the item read serving the overlay (one identity), translation plus base serving the edit in both locales while the sibling stays translated, the no-base control reproducing the defect, and reset. The objectql `local` project passed: 336 files, 6682 tests.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` passed: 190 files, 2792 tests. `typecheck` is green for spec (with its test layer), metadata-protocol and objectql (with its test layer).
- **Ablation 1** (spec, source-resolved, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the widget-title guard was replaced with `false && …`; the anchor went from 1 to 0 and the blob changed. The `-t 20680` run turned 3 red: the edited title, the tenant-added widget, and the dispatcher. The file was restored, with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Ablation 2** (metadata-protocol, through `dist`): the accessor was made to return `registry.getItem` (the trap). After a rebuild, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files, and 2 tests went red: shadow immunity, and the no-code-package case. Restore leg: rebuild, `--absent` over 24 built files, tree clean, 8 of 8 green.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 96 families. I ran all 96 at `d89ebb8c1c` and all exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "96 derived, 96 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `check:engine-double-contract` asked for the new double to be recorded, so `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains one `findOne` row, written by the gate's `--write`. `check:objectql-double-limit` asked for the double's `find` to honour `limit`.
- Narrowed lint: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 4 TypeScript files in the diff reported 4 files, 0 errors and 0 warnings. That population comes from the config's own `files` glob (`**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}`); the other 3 changed paths are `.md` and `.json`. The config never enables type-aware linting (its own header says so: no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot move the verdict for an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Dormant until the REST child.** With this PR alone, no served answer changes (measured above). The `translations.mdx` sentence describing the rule for dashboards belongs with the child that makes the rule observable.
- **The console's board is not measured.** Read from objectui source at `9fd6c2c`, not at the pinned `dd3f7e1`, which is absent locally: `DashboardRenderer`'s `tWidgetTitle` re-resolves `dashboards.NAME.widgets.WIDGET_ID.title` client-side, and a bundle entry wins over the served title. If so, the rendered board would keep the shipped string even after the server serves the edit. This is a read-only inference and no card is filed. The carrier is the REST child's browser verification.
- **A same-family reading on views** (measured in this boot): an org overlay on `showcase_task.in_progress` ("In Progress (edited-20680)") is served in en, but a zh-CN reader, admin or member, item or list, gets "进行中". This is the same catalog-over-overlay shape one type over. The seat files it as its own finding (5900364303); it is not fixed here.
- The branch is 7 commits behind `origin/main`, and none of them touches these paths. The merge queue rebuilds the PR on the current main.
